title: dossier_entry
description: One reader's entry for one inventory item of an L2 absorb (Implementation Decisions 9): the item it answers, where in the source it was read, the item in exact form, how much it matters, how it bears on the intent, and what looked odd. A figure's entry also says what the figure shows, whether it supports the claim that cites it, and anything odd about it. One line of refs/<slug>/entries.jsonl; the coverage audit counts these against the inventory.

item_id.description: the inventory item this entry answers, as the obligation list names it

chunk_id.description: the chunk the entry was read from; filled in by the fan-out, not by the reader

locator.description: where the item was read: <file>:<line> in the source, or a page of a PDF

content.description: the item in exact form: an equation's LaTeX as the source writes it, a theorem's statement word for word, a table's cells, a section's argument in the paper's own terms

importance.description: 1 is incidental to the paper, 5 is what the paper stands on

relation_to_intent.description: how this item bears on the project's intent; empty when it does not

oddities.description: anything that does not add up: a number that disagrees with another, a step that is skipped, a symbol never defined

what_it_shows.description: figures: what the image actually shows, read off the image rather than the caption

supports_cited_claim.description: figures: the claim that cites the figure, and whether what it shows supports it

anything_odd.description: figures: axes, scales, error bars, or panels that mislead or disagree with the text; empty when nothing is
